title: 第7章 每天来一次我就给你第8章 气运为负
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: “九阳灭世诀？品阶极高的火属性功法！”
徐墨闻言，赶忙接过散发炙热能量的玉简，心神激动不已。
他光是听这个功法名字，就能感觉出它的强大！
要知道慕容雪可是准帝境的超级强者！
能被准帝称之为品阶极高的，那最少也会是圣阶功法吧？
要知道圣阶功法就算是底蕴深厚的合欢圣地，也才只有两部而已，而且还都只是圣阶初级。
“多谢师尊，我十日后会再来的！”
徐墨已经迫不及待的想要回宫殿查看功法了，跟慕容雪道了声谢后，就急忙离开了。
在看到徐墨离开后，慕容雪紧绷的身躯这才彻底放松了下来，一边喘息，一边伸出玉手，放在了自己的胸口上。
怦，怦，怦！
没错，方才徐墨感受到的急促心跳，并不是他的错觉，确实是慕容雪所发出的。
毕竟，这可是慕容雪第一次与异性这般亲密的接触。
你要说不紧张，那绝对是不可能的。
至于其他的感觉嘛？
慕容雪沉默了片刻，喃喃自语道，“倒是也还不错！”
也不知道是不是因为徐墨是太阳圣体的原因，她刚刚在徐墨怀中时，竟觉得非常温暖且安全，她刚才甚至想要和徐墨抱的更久一点。
而且徐墨刚才也仅仅只是帮她缓解了寒毒而已，并没有干一些其他的坏事，这让慕容雪对他的印象好了一点。
不过也仅限于一点而已。
将紧张的内心平复下来后，慕容雪又陷入了沉思。
寒毒这个东西，会随着实力的不断变强，使得发作逐渐变多，威力也逐渐增强。
她现在的境界太高了，所以她体内的寒毒自然十分恐怖。
她现在能明显感觉到，用不了一年时间，纵然有徐墨出手帮忙，也无法在压制缓解寒毒了。
不过解决办法也不是没有！
那就是在这一年时间内，将寒毒彻底根除，这是她之前一直在寻找的办法，也是之前在荒古世界各域游历的原因。
现在她终于找到了！
可是，根除寒毒需要付出的代价，她现在根本办不到！
慕容雪紧咬樱唇，双手捏着衣角。
徐墨在回到圣子殿后，便迫不及待地将那枚散发炙热能量的红色玉简拿出，将精神探入其中。
在探入的瞬间，一道滔天热浪顿时从玉简中喷涌而出，将徐墨整个人笼罩。
热浪的温度极高，要不是徐墨身怀太阳圣体，还真抵挡不住，这要是换作普通的化神修士，光这股能量就能把人烧成灰烬。
content_en:
"Nine Yang Art of Destroying the World? An extremely high-grade fire attribute technique!"
Hearing this, Xu Mo quickly took over the jade slip that radiated hot energy, feeling extremely excited.
Just by hearing the name of this technique, he could feel how powerful it was!
You must know that Murong Xue is a super strong person in the quasi-emperor realm!
If the quasi-emperor can call it an extremely high-level skill, then it must be at least a holy-level skill, right?
You must know that even the Hehuan Holy Land, which has a profound foundation of holy-level exercises, only has two sets, and they are only at the beginning of the holy level.
"Thank you Master, I will come back in ten days!"
Xu Mo couldn't wait to go back to the palace to check out the skills. After thanking Murong Xue, he hurriedly left.
After seeing Xu Mo leave, Murong Xue's tense body completely relaxed. While panting, she stretched out her jade hand and placed it on her chest.
Thump, thump, thump!
That's right, the rapid heartbeat that Xu Mo felt just now was not his illusion, it was indeed caused by Murong Xue.
After all, this was the first time Murong Xue had such close contact with the opposite sex.
It is absolutely impossible to say that you are not nervous.
What about other feelings?
Murong Xue was silent for a moment and murmured to herself, "It's not bad at all!"
She didn't know if it was because Xu Mo was the Holy Body of the Sun. When she was in Xu Mo's arms, she felt very warm and safe. She even wanted to hold Xu Mo for a little longer just now.
Moreover, Xu Mo just helped her relieve the cold poison and did not do any other bad things, which made Murong Xue's impression of him a little better.
But it's only limited to one point.
After calming down her nervousness, Murong Xue fell into deep thought again.
Cold Poison will gradually become more powerful as its strength continues to grow, resulting in more attacks and more power.
Her current realm is too high, so the cold poison in her body is naturally very terrifying.
She could clearly feel now that in less than a year, even with Xu Mo's help, she would not be able to suppress and alleviate the cold poison.
But there is no solution!
That is to completely eradicate the cold poison within this year. This is the method she has been looking for before, and it is also the reason why she traveled to various regions in the ancient world.
Now she finally found it!
However, the price required to eradicate the cold poison is something she simply cannot do now!
Murong Xue bit her lips tightly and held the corners of her clothes with both hands.
…
After Xu Mo returned to the Holy Son Hall, he couldn't wait to take out the red jade slip that radiated hot energy and put his spirit into it.
The moment he probed in, a monstrous heat wave spurted out from the jade slip, covering Xu Mo's entire body.
The temperature of the heat wave was extremely high. If Xu Mo hadn't carried the Holy Body of the Sun, he really couldn't withstand it. If it were an ordinary cultivator of god transformation, this energy alone could burn people to ashes.
